definitions.explanation: Food ordered to be eaten elsewhere rather than on the premises.

examples.japanese: テイクアウト⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願いします：00981_onegaishimasu⟧。
examples.english: I'd like it to go, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧テイクアウト⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
⟦コロナ{禍|か}→コロナ禍：29315_koronaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧テイクアウト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Demand for takeout increased during the COVID-19 pandemic.

notes:
LOANWORD:
From English 'takeout' or 'take out.'

JAPANESE EQUIVALENTS:
- ⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}り→持ち帰り：08161_mochikaeri⟧ (the traditional Japanese term)
- ⟦お{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}り→持ち帰り：08161_mochikaeri⟧ (polite form)

REGISTER:
Neutral to casual. Common in urban areas and chain restaurants.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- テイクアウト⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to get takeout)
- テイクアウト⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧ (takeout available)
- テイクアウト⟦{専門店|せんもんてん}→専門店：15924_senmonten⟧ (takeout-only shop)

CULTURAL NOTE:
テイクアウト became especially common during the COVID-19 pandemic. Many restaurants that didn't offer it before started providing takeout options.
